`n_zero_rows` is computed at superposition_strength.py and never used or emitted (carried over from the previous round, still unfixed); the dropped-row count is not auditable.

mean_squared_overlap_centered drops zero rows of the CENTERED matrix while superposition_ratio_centered divides by welch_bound(V_eff, m) computed from the RAW matrix; the two counts can differ (requires a row exactly equal to the column mean), leaving the centered ratio able to dip below the bound.
